value.headline: Iced Matcha Latte up 27.9% in four weeks; Miso Banana Loaf down 21.9%.

industry_trend.claim: UK cafés face a structural matcha supply shortage, with tencha auction prices peaking around ¥22,000/kg in May 2026 and wholesale prices up roughly 40–50% year-on-year.

nudges.rationale: It's our fastest-growing item, up 27.9% recently (averaging 601 units a week). So what: Demand is already there, but if supply chain costs are squeezing margins, this is the volume driver you need to keep the lights on. Keep the ice machine prepped and the oats stocked.
nudges.title: Push the Iced Matcha Latte.

nudges.rationale: Sales dropped 21.9% over the last four weeks (down to 96 units a week). So what: We're wasting prep time and bin money on a treat that's cooling off. Reduce your order this week and reallocate that labor to items that are actually flying out the door.
nudges.title: Pull the Miso Banana Loaf.

nudges.rationale: 8.2% of matcha customers are adding a pastry (445 out of 5,438). So what: That leaves £207 of weekly opportunity on the table. Matcha drinkers are your best customers—train the baristas to suggest the hojicha latte's perfect pairing at the register.
nudges.title: Fix the Matcha Attach Rate.

value.sell_summary: Revenue was £157,469 over 13 weeks from 26,023 transactions, but net profit sits at -£2,705; we should push higher-margin bakery attachments to lift margins as matcha demand remains strong.
value.supplier_email_draft:
Subject: Adjusting this week's matcha & bakery order

Hi [Supplier Name],

Hope you're having a good week.

Looking at our till data for the last month, our Iced Matcha Lattes are absolutely flying right now (up nearly 28% in volume). Because of the current market shortages and price hikes, I want to make sure we lock in our supply before it dips. Can we add an extra [insert amount/kg] of [specific matcha grade] to this week's order to keep us buffered?

On the flip side, our Miso Banana Loaf has slowed down a bit (down about 22% recently). To avoid waste, please cut our usual order for that by [insert percentage/amount] for this week's delivery. 

Let me know if you can accommodate that matcha buffer, and I'll send over the updated PO.

Best,
[Your Name]
